sources.observation: The square stone westwork has paired arcades, two steep spires and a tall gabled center. The pale wing beside it has three window rows and roof chimneys.

sources.credit: UNESCO World Heritage Centre, credited in the site gallery.
sources.observation: The church and cloister lie against the north edge of the outer court. The north ranges have individually sloping slate roofs and corner towers.

limitations: The exterior model includes the main abbey buildings. Minor dormers, carved relief and courtyard grading are approximate. Archaeological remains and the surrounding independent buildings retain their map layers.
